_doc: Tile geometry (PLAN.md 4.1). Shapes are defined for an edge length of 1; a size scales them. All lengths are in U (1 U = one Large edge = 64 px). Every attachable edge must be a whole number of port pitches long.

wedge._doc: Right-isosceles triangle. Edge 1 is the hypotenuse (length sqrt 2), which has no ports.
